title: Bad CIBIL Loan App List 2026: Safe Options & Score Repair
summary: Bad CIBIL loan app list for India: regulated apps that consider low scores, the 400 and 500 CIBIL reality, traps to avoid, and how to repair your score.
body_markdown:
Searching for a **bad CIBIL loan app list** usually means one thing: you need money, but your credit score is standing in the way. This guide gives you the honest, complete picture: what a bad CIBIL score really means, which regulated apps actually consider low-score borrowers, the traps to avoid, and how to repair your score so you stop needing this list at all.


## What Does a Bad CIBIL Score Mean?


CIBIL scores run from 300 to 900. Banks and NBFCs read them like this:


Score range What lenders see Loan reality


750-900 Excellent Best rates, easy approvals


650-749 Fair to good Most apps approve, average rates


550-649 Poor Some NBFC apps approve smaller amounts at higher rates


400-549 Very poor Unsecured loans mostly rejected; secured routes work


Below 400 or no score No usable history Build history first with secured products


Two honest truths before the list. First, a **400 CIBIL loan app** that promises instant unsecured cash mostly does not exist in the regulated world; at that score, secured options are the real path. Second, at 500-650, several genuine NBFC-backed apps do lend (see[how to get an instant loan](https://gromo.in/blog/how-to-get-instant-loan/) safely), just smaller amounts at higher interest, and repaying them on time is exactly how your score climbs back.


## Bad CIBIL Loan App List: Regulated Options That Consider Low Scores


These apps lend through RBI-regulated NBFCs and banks and are known to consider borrowers with poor or thin credit histories. Approval is never guaranteed; each lender decides on your full profile, and amounts offered at low scores are smaller:


App Known for Low CIBIL reality


KreditBee Small personal loans, fast processing Considers thin files; starts small, grows with repayment


Kissht Instant credit and EMIs Considers moderate scores; clean recent history helps


LendingPlate Short-tenure salaried loans Salary strength can offset a weaker score


mPokket Micro loans for students and young workers Small tickets, lighter score requirements


CASHe Salary-based credit lines Uses income profile beyond just CIBIL


Fibe (EarlySalary) Salary advances Salaried profiles with average scores often pass


FatakPay Small digital credit Entry-level amounts for weaker files


Ring App-based small credit Considers lower scores for small limits


Moneyview Flexible personal loans States acceptance of scores from the mid-600s


Zype Quick small loans Young salaried profiles with thin files


Before applying to any of them, do the one check that matters: confirm the app and its lending partner in the **RBI's Digital Lending Apps (DLA) directory** (see our[RBI approved loan apps](https://gromo.in/blog/rbi-approved-loan-apps/) guide) on the RBI website. That directory is what people actually mean when they search for a bad CIBIL loan app list that is RBI approved: RBI approves lenders, not loan apps, so the right question is always which regulated lender is behind the app.


## Secured Options When Your Score Is Very Low (400-550)


1. **Loan against fixed deposit:** banks lend up to 90% of your FD instantly, with no score check, at low interest.
2. **Gold loan:** approved on the gold's value, not your CIBIL, from banks and regulated NBFCs.
3. **Secured credit card against FD:** not a loan, but the fastest score-repair tool; on-time bills rebuild your CIBIL within months.
4. **Loan with a co-applicant or guarantor:** a family member's good score can carry the application.


## The 7 Days Loan App Low CIBIL Trap


Apps advertising 7 days loan with no CIBIL check are the most dangerous corner of digital lending (our[7 days loan apps list](https://gromo.in/blog/7-days-loan-apps-list/) covers the safe alternatives in depth). No regulated lender skips credit assessment entirely; these apps replace it with your phone contacts and photo gallery as collateral, then recover through harassment and shaming. Their fees eat the loan itself: Rs 1,000 borrowed, Rs 700 received, full Rs 1,000 plus penalties due in a week. If an app demands contact access, promises guaranteed approval, or deducts big fees upfront, uninstall it; our[fake loan apps list](https://gromo.in/blog/fake-loan-apps-list/) tracks known offenders. A very bad CIBIL score is fixable; leaked photos and harassed family members are much harder to undo.


## Check and Improve Your Score with GroScore


The permanent way out of bad CIBIL is knowing your score and fixing it step by step.[GroScore](https://groscore.in/?ref=gromo.in) lets you check your credit score and understand what is pulling it down, and its credit guide **Arjun** helps you improve it: which accounts to pay first, how utilization is hurting you, what to dispute, and how long recovery will take. Checking your own score is a soft inquiry and never reduces it, so check first, fix what Arjun points at, and apply for loans only when your approval odds are real.


## Safety Tips Before Using Any Low CIBIL Loan App


1. Verify the app's lending partner in the RBI DLA directory; no named lender means uninstall.
2. Read the Key Fact Statement before accepting: fees, interest, and tenure must be shown upfront.
3. Never pay any fee to receive a loan; advance fee demands are pure fraud.
4. Refuse contact list and gallery permissions; a lender needs KYC documents only.
5. Borrow the smallest amount that solves the problem, and only what your next income can repay.
6. Prefer 1-3 month tenures over 7-day cliffs, and repay on time; every on-time EMI rebuilds your score.
7. Facing harassment? Report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930, and complain on RBI's Sachet portal.


## How to Fix a Bad CIBIL Score in 6-12 Months


The short version is below; for the complete playbook, read[how to improve your credit score in India](https://gromo.in/blog/how-to-improve-credit-score-india-2026/) .


1. Check your report on GroScore and dispute any errors; wrong entries are more common than people think.
2. Clear small overdue amounts first; every account marked settled or current helps.
3. Take a secured credit card against a small FD and pay the full bill on time every month.
4. Keep credit utilization under 30% of your limits.
5. Do not apply to many lenders at once; each hard inquiry dents the score further.
6. Give it time and consistency; most people move from the 500s to 700+ within a year of clean behaviour.


## FAQ: Bad CIBIL Loan App List


**Is there a 400 CIBIL loan app in India?**


For unsecured instant loans, effectively no; regulated lenders rarely approve unsecured credit at 400. Apps that promise otherwise are usually unregulated traps. At 400, the real options are secured: a loan against your fixed deposit, a gold loan, a loan with a guarantor, or a secured credit card to start rebuilding. Six months of clean secured-card usage moves your score into ranges where genuine apps start saying yes.


**Which 500 CIBIL loan apps are genuine?**


Around 500-600, apps like KreditBee, Kissht, FatakPay, and mPokket sometimes approve small amounts based on your income and recent behaviour, through their RBI-regulated lending partners. Expect smaller limits and higher interest, verify each app's lender in the RBI DLA directory first, and treat the loan as a score-rebuilding tool by repaying strictly on time.


**Are 7 days loan apps safe for low CIBIL score borrowers?**


No. Strict 7-day loan apps targeting low CIBIL borrowers are the highest-risk category: unregulated lenders, huge upfront fee deductions, contact list access as collateral, and harassment-based recovery. Regulated short-term lenders offer 1-3 month tenures instead. If you are already stuck with one, repay only genuine dues, refuse extortion, and report harassment at cybercrime.gov.in or helpline 1930.


**Is there an RBI approved bad CIBIL loan app list?**


The RBI does not approve loan apps or publish a low-CIBIL app list. What it publishes is the Digital Lending Apps (DLA) directory, which shows which apps are linked to RBI-regulated banks and NBFCs. That is the only list that matters: any app you consider, from this article or anywhere else, should have its lending partner verifiable there.


**How can I improve my bad CIBIL score fast?**


Check your score and report on GroScore and let its credit guide Arjun show you what is hurting most: errors to dispute, overdues to clear, and utilization to cut. Then run the basics: a secured credit card paid in full on time, utilization under 30%, no burst of new applications. Most people see real movement in 3-6 months and cross 700 within a year of clean behaviour.
